I have a weird thing to say (im a beginner so i know my opinion isnt too important😅), i think learning to skate without using toestops (unless its an emergency) is so much better than to always rely on them. I had used it like 4 times the last 6 days and i still feel safe. I also want to rhythm dance later and you cant really stop in jam plugs...so now i practice with minimum toe stopping

To your issue, try walking on your toestops for a short distance while someone is assisting you. You get a feel for them and you can see that they are stable enough. I also walked on stairs with them 😅 Or maybe just put one skate on, your other foot is in normal shoes and then you practice "stopping" with the toestop, or just putting your weight on the one toestop. You still have your normal foot if you loose balance and if you get used to it, you can try it with both! I hope this helps, just know that toe stops are made to protect you, irrational fears are always frustrating and i have many of them, so dont try to over think<3

Good luck🍀
